definitions.different_actual_arrivals: Compared independently executed same-initial-state pairs by actual shipment/request line allocation.
definitions.linked_arrivals: Actual arrivals of those strong accepted orders. Does not by itself prove different arrival than a counterfactual.
definitions.same_state_shadow: Read-only observed ranking difference at a real matching snapshot, not an executed counterfactual.
definitions.strong_price_sensitive: First actual round of price-first policy; same dated need, >=2 positive current timely executable payable different-price offers; shadow policies differ; chosen price-first line subsequently accepted.
